extension.name: CiviVolunteer NG (Next Generation by MadGophers)
extension.description: INDEPENDENT FORK of CiviVolunteer with modern Angular architecture for CiviCRM 6.9+. Features conflict detection, removed legacy Backbone/Marionette dependencies, and simplified profile handling. NOT affiliated with official CiviVolunteer project. Use at your own risk.
extension.comments: Modernized version with Phase 0 (removed org.civicrm.angularprofiles dependency) and Phase 1 (conflict detection for preventing double-booking). Original development by Ginkgo Street Labs and CiviCRM, LLC with contributions from the community. Special thanks to Friends of Georgia State Parks & Historic Sites for funding the initial release, and to The Manhattan Neighborhood Network for funding the 1.4 release.
